title: Use of transwell system to analyze T lymphocyte migration across lymphatic endothelium
protocol: Check tissue culture flasks to ensure endothelial cell cultures are viable and have achieved confluence.
Prepare 0.1% gelatin mixture by placing ingredients into a glass flask.
Heat and stir the mixture gently for 4-5 minutes until it clears.
Pass the mixture through a filtration system (Corning).
Remove transwell inserts from 24 well plates and place them inverted into a 12 well plate.
Pipette 100 μL of 0.1% gelatin solution over each inverted transwell insert.
Place the plate into an incubator at 37°C for 2 hours.
Passage cells as described in the manufacturer's protocol, placing cells into a 50cc conical tube and centrifuge at 250 x g, 4°C, for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Add 1 ml of culture medium and count live cells with 0.02% Trypan Blue.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 7.5x10^5 cells/ml.
Remove the plate from the incubator and remove liquid gelatin overlying insert with a pipette, being careful not to scratch or puncture the membrane.
Place 100 μl of resuspended cells (7.5x10^4 cells) on inverted gelatin covered transwell insert.
Replace into incubator for 3 days.
Remove culture plate from incubator.
Remove a single transwell insert from the culture plate and replace plate into incubator.
Fix transwell in methanol for 30 seconds.
Place sample in Hematoxylin component stain for 30 seconds.
Transfer sample to Eosin component stain for 30 seconds.
Rinse in water for 5 seconds.
Remove mesh membrane with endothelial cells from transwell insert with sharp forceps, being careful not disrupt the cell monolayer.
Place on slide with tissue fixative and cover with slide cover.
Assess for evenly confluent cell layer.
Euthanize mice.
Retrieve desired tissues for T cell harvest, e.g., spleen, lymph nodes, etc.
Place tissues in 50 ml conical tubes with 15 ml complete RPMI medium 1640.
Carefully dissociate tissues, removing stromal components.
Wash cells x3, 250 x g, 4°C, for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and treat cells with ACK Red Blood Cell lysing buffer per manufacturer's protocol.
Treat for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 30 ml media and wash x3 at 250 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in 1-2 ml 1x R & D T-cell enrichment column buffer.
Isolate T cells via enrichment column per manufacturer’s protocol.
Wash isolated T cells x3 at 250 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml complete medium.
Count cells using 0.02% Trypan Blue stain.
Resuspend T cells at a concentration of 5x10^6 cells/ml and store on ice.
Prepare inverted transwell inserts by removing the bead of medium with a 200 μl pipette carefully without scratching the membrane surface.
Replace inverted transwell inserts into proper position in 24 well plates from their original 12 well plate setup.
Place 600 μl of complete medium containing appropriate chemotactic signal in the bottom wells.
Add 100 μl of previously prepared T cells (5x10^5 cells) to the upper chamber of transwell for each condition.
Set up wells in triplicate for each condition.
Incubate at 37°C for 4 hours.
Remove plate from incubator.
Remove transwell inserts.
Gently agitate remaining unmigrated cells in upper chamber with a pipette and remove for quantification.
Resuspend cells in lower well in 1 ml medium.
Count cells using hemacytometer to quantify migration.
